steps.input:
N=22
grid=[[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
def put(cells,color,dr=0,dc=0):
    for r,c in cells:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        assert 0<=rr<N and 0<=cc<N,(color,rr,cc)
        assert grid[rr][cc] in (0,2,color), (color,rr,cc,grid[rr][cc])
        grid[rr][cc]=color
def put2(cells,dr=0,dc=0):
    for r,c in cells:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        assert 0<=rr<N and 0<=cc<N,(rr,cc)
        assert grid[rr][cc] in (0,2), (rr,cc,grid[rr][cc])
        grid[rr][cc]=2
# central 4
put([(r,c) for r in range(8,11) for c in range(10,13)],4)
put2([(7,11),(9,9),(11,10),(11,12)])
# 3 component, translate -9,-8
c3=[(13,c) for c in range(14,20)]+[(r,c) for r in (14,15) for c in (14,19)]+[(16,14),(17,14)]+[(18,c) for c in (14,15,16)]
m3=[(14,13),(16,19),(17,13),(18,17)]
put(c3,3,-9,-8); put2(m3,-9,-8)
# 7 component translate +2,-1
c7=[(3,c) for c in range(2,6)]+[(4,2),(5,2)]+[(6,c) for c in range(2,6)]
m7=[(3,6),(6,6)]
put(c7,7,2,-1); put2(m7,2,-1)
# 9 component translate -6,+7
c9=[(18,3),(18,5),(19,3),(19,5)]+[(20,c) for c in range(2,7)]
m9=[(17,3),(17,5),(21,2),(21,6)]
put(c9,9,-6,7); put2(m9,-6,7)
# 8 component translate +14,-7
c8=[(2,16),(2,20)]+[(3,c) for c in range(16,21)]
m8=[(1,16),(1,20)]
put(c8,8,14,-7); put2(m8,14,-7)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
